q1_issues.issue: 'its highest alert' is a specific possessed NP but is encoded as the bare class constant highest_alert, which the Existential section reserves for non-specific / generic objects.
The possessive 'its' is dropped — no Possession/PartOf links the alert level to the force, so whose alert level it was goes unrecorded.
The compound keeps the unlemmatized superlative (highest_alert) while its exposed modifier genus is lemmatized to high, so the superlative degree is both unrecorded and inconsistently rendered.

q2_gaps: an attributive superlative inside an NP ('its highest alert') — Comparatives & degree covers only predicative superlatives (Most) and comparatives
a performative / journalistic 'can' ('The Telegraph can reveal that ...'), which is not a capability claim about the subject
notes: Treating 'reveal that P' as factive (sealed Theme plus the flattened top-level bundle) and giving it Experiencer follows the Propositional attitudes section, and the appositive title correctly takes the host clause's Past wrapper. (Patient sk_force_1) is arguable — 'place X on alert' is not displacement, but the unclear-case default in Thematic roles is Theme.
